letter.body: In the quiet language of flowers, each petal carries what words could never say.

Some feelings arrive without words. In the quiet language of flowers, each petal carries what the heart could never say in haste.

May this bouquet bring a gentle stillness to your evening.
Testing end to end audit gift flow.

My love, whenever life becomes heavy, whenever the world feels like too much and your heart gets tired of carrying everything, run back to me. You don't have to explain everything. You don't have to be strong with me. You don't have to hide your tears or pretend that you're okay. Just come to me, exactly as you are, and let me hold everything you couldn't carry alone.

I want to be the person you can come home to after the hardest day of your life. The person you can sit beside in silence when words aren't enough. The person who reminds you that one bad day, one failure, one mistake, or one painful chapter can never define the beautiful person you are.

And if life gives you a hundred reasons to break, I'll give you a hundred reasons to keep going.

When you lose faith in yourself, I'll believe in you until you find that faith again. When you're exhausted, I'll walk beside you. When you're scared, I'll hold your hand. When you fall, I won't ask why you fell—I’ll reach for you and help you stand again. And when you finally reach the places you've dreamed of reaching, I'll be there, looking at you with a heart full of pride, knowing how hard you fought to get there.

I can't promise that I'll be able to take every pain away from you. I can't promise that life will always be kind to us. But I can promise you this: you will never have to face it feeling unloved.

I will love you through the beautiful days and the unbearable ones. Through your laughter and your tears. Through your confidence and your doubts. Through the moments when you feel like you can conquer the world and the moments when simply getting out of bed feels like a victory.

I want to love every version of you.

Not just the girl who smiles.
Not just the girl who is happy.
You. All of you.

Because I don't want to be someone who is only there when life is easy. I want to be there when life tests you. I want to stand beside you when everything feels uncertain and remind you, again and again, "You don't have to do this alone. I'm here."

And Sama, I need you to know something.

I don't see you as a temporary chapter in my life. I see you in my future.

I want to build a life with you. I want to see your dreams become real. I want to watch you become the woman you've always wanted to be. I want to celebrate your victories, protect our little moments, laugh with you over the stupidest things, argue with you over things we'll probably forget, make memories with you, grow old with you, and wake up one day and realize that somehow, through everything life threw at us, we still chose each other.

So whenever life becomes too heavy, don't run away from love.

Run back to me.

Bring me your sadness. Bring me your fears. Bring me the parts of yourself you think are too broken to be loved.

I'll still be here.

And I'll love you so fiercely and so completely that, even if for a moment, you'll remember that life hasn't only given you pain.

It gave me you.

And I will spend every day I can making sure you never forget how deeply, hopelessly, and endlessly you are loved.

I don't know what our entire future holds, Sama.
But I know who I want beside me when I find out.

You.

Today.
Tomorrow.
On the easy days.
On the impossible ones.
And through every chapter that comes after.

If the whole world ever becomes too heavy for you, come to me.
I'll carry whatever I can, and I'll hold your hand through whatever I can't.

Because I don't just want to love you.

I want to be your home. ❤️
In quiet sanctuaries, rare beauty speaks without words.
Thank you for standing beside me in every storm.
Like the midnight Kadupul, some moments remain timeless.
In the quiet language of flowers, each petal carries what words could never say.
May peace and joy fill your new home.
